readme:
# TripAdvisor Scraper

Get hotel, restaurant and attraction listings from [TripAdvisor](https://www.tripadvisor.com/) list pages. Paste the address of a list page, such as the restaurants of a city, and the actor returns one record per listing: name, link, location ID, rating, review count, price level, cuisines and categories, address, coordinates, phone, ranking, image and opening hours. No login and no API key are needed.

## What you get

- One record per listing from a TripAdvisor list page, 30 listings per page.
- Several pages in one run. Set `maxResults` and the actor reads as many pages as it needs.
- Each listing once per run, even if it shows up on more than one page.
- A run that is interrupted continues where it stopped. Listings already delivered are not delivered or charged again.
- You pay only for listings that were saved to the dataset.

## Use with AI agents (MCP)

Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client, such as Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain or LlamaIndex.

**MCP server URL:**

```
https://mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/tripadvisor-scraper
```

**Example prompt once connected:**

> "Use `tripadvisor-scraper` to list the first 60 restaurants in Paris from TripAdvisor with their ratings, review counts and addresses as a CSV."

| `categories` | `["Restaurants"]` |

Fields that a page does not show are returned empty. List pages do not show a long description for most listings.

## Pricing

Pay-per-event pricing. You pay only for listings that were saved to the dataset.

| Event | Price |
|-------|-------|
| Actor start (`actor-start`) | $0.001 |
| Listing scraped (`tripadvisor-listing-result`) | $2.50 / 1,000 |

The start event is charged once per run, together with the first saved listing. A run that returns nothing is not charged. If you set a maximum cost per run, the actor stops before it goes over that limit.

## Input

| Field | Type | Description | Default |
|-------|------|-------------|---------|
| `locationUrls` | string[] | TripAdvisor list pages, for example `https://www.tripadvisor.com/Restaurants-g187147-Paris_Ile_de_France.html`. Hotels, restaurants and things to do list pages work. | none |
| `directUrls` | string[] | Single listing pages (Hotel_Review, Restaurant_Review, Attraction_Review). One page gives one record. | none |
| `maxResults` | integer | Most listings to return across all inputs. 0 uses 100. | `100` |

At least one of `locationUrls` or `directUrls` is required.

## Usage examples

### First 40 restaurants in Paris

```json
{
  "locationUrls": ["https://www.tripadvisor.com/Restaurants-g187147-Paris_Ile_de_France.html"],
  "maxResults": 40
}
```

### Hotels in two cities

```json
{
  "locationUrls": [
    "https://www.tripadvisor.com/Hotels-g187791-Rome_Lazio.html",
    "https://www.tripadvisor.com/Hotels-g187497-Barcelona_Catalonia.html"
  ],
  "maxResults": 100
}
```

### One listing page

```json
{
  "directUrls": [
    "https://www.tripadvisor.com/Restaurant_Review-g187147-d719424-Reviews-Le_Jules_Verne-Paris_Ile_de_France.html"
  ]
}
```

## Output

Results are saved to the default dataset. Export them as JSON, CSV or Excel, or read them through the API.

## FAQ

**Which pages should I use?**
List pages, such as the restaurants, hotels or things to do of a city. They give 30 listings per request, which keeps runs fast and cost low.

**How many listings can I get from one list?**
TripAdvisor shows up to a few hundred pages for a list. The actor reads pages until it has `maxResults` listings or the list ends.

**What does a run cost?**
$0.001 to start plus $2.50 per 1,000 listings. A run of 40 listings costs about $0.10.

**What status does a run end with?**
The run status says how many listings were delivered. If TripAdvisor refuses every request, the run fails and nothing is charged. If a page has no listings, the run ends normally and says so.

**Can I get reviews?**
This actor returns listing data: rating summary, address, contact details and ranking. It does not return the text of individual reviews.
